parameters.name: LLM Model
parameters.description: The lead model; verified to take image_url on this build (2026-08-30).

parameters.name: Postgres Password
parameters.description: Sensitive — set via the API after upload from ~/.env STREAMER_BRAIN_DB_PASSWORD; never in this file.

parameters.name: Qdrant URL
parameters.description: qdrant-kb (docker); the streamer-kb collection lives here.

parameters.name: Postgres Driver Jar
parameters.description: Ships in the CFM NiFi image.

parameters.name: Door Port
parameters.description: HandleHttpRequest port inside mynifi-0; exposed by files/streamers/streamer-brain-door.yaml (NodePort 32111).

parameters.name: Postgres User
parameters.description: SELECT on the streamer_brain view only.

parameters.name: vLLM Base URL
parameters.description: The box's vLLM (docker, LAN-published); pods reach it at the LAN address.

parameters.name: Frames Per Clip
parameters.description: Evenly spaced frames per clip (+1 at the audio peak, added by clip-prep).
